LESSON: ISLAMIC

Grade: PP1
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: MORAL
Topic 4.1.3: Islamic

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Islamic. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How do we greet?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. appreciate the importance • Learners practice Islamic greeting e.g.. of using Islamic greeting skit/role-play. in daily life • Learners listen to and sing songs
2. apply Islamic greeting related to Islamic greeting. appropriately while • In pairs or small groups

1. appreciate the importance • Learners practice Islamic greeting e.g.. of using Islamic greeting skit/role-play. in daily life • Learners listen to and sing songs

   In simple words: practise until you can apply Islamic greeting related to Islamic greeting. appropriately while • In pairs or small groups. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Islamic using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Islamic in the examples.
2. Explain Islamic to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Islamic.
4. Show that you can: appreciate the importance • Learners practice Islamic greeting e.g.. of using Islamic greeting skit/role-play. in daily life • Learners listen to and sing songs

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Islamic using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Islamic important for a PP1 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

2. Learners listen to and sing songs c) apply Islamic greeting related to Islamic greeting. appropriately while
